description: This file is a React component for the Explore Roles page in a Next.js frontend. It handles user interactions for searching and filtering roles, fetches role data and suggestions from backend APIs, and renders the UI including search bar, filters, suggested roles, and role results.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path into a full URL, handling slashes appropriately.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range string in USD format and converts it into a range in INR lakhs, handling various suffixes like K/M/B.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Maps backend role search result object to UI role object with defaults and computed fields.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Converts recommended role data into UI role object with a descriptive summary.
